theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_pr_det_covector_laplace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (g : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P) (k : Fin (d + 1)) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (g b) (u a))) → ∃ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, ∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ (g k) (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
